Crafting Window Rework 

Unlearned recipes are now shown in gray

[hr][/hr]
General Fixes & QoL 
Vendor interactions now show correctly when Quick Move is not possible 
Fixed blockers in the hub 
Faster server inventory synchronization Inventory items in loot chests can no longer be split (only in your own inventory)

notes.title: Usurpator – Patch Notes Juli 2025
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35266443/413fbf595c614b2ad2a3fd3f7b249c3dbb0cb224.png"]
[hr][/hr]
Rune Sockets:

Locked Rune Sockets: Rune sockets that have not been unlocked yet are now displayed with a lock icon.

Unlocked but Empty Rune Sockets: Empty rune sockets are now shown as empty, indicating they do not contain any rune.

Rune Sockets with Runes: Rune sockets containing runes now display the corresponding icon of the rune inside.

Visual Changes to Rune Sockets: Rune sockets now appear differently in the forging window compared to the weapon tooltip.

New State for Rune Sockets: Rune sockets now feature an "IsAssignedUnpaid" state, which is visually highlighted.

Rune Socket Effects: Existing rune socket effects now appear in gray, while newly added effects are highlighted in white.

Weapon Highlighting: When runes are inserted into a weapon, the weapon is visually highlighted.
[hr][/hr]
Forging and Weapon Enhancement:

Revamped Forge Window: The upgrade area in the forge window has been completely redesigned, making it clearer and more intuitive when unlocking rune sockets.

Immediate Database Updates: Weapon upgrades and rune enhancements are now immediately written to the player database for faster response times.

Enhanced Animations: Weapon upgrades and enhancements now feature an animation, smoothly hiding the server write process for a better user experience.
[hr][/hr]
Crafting Improvements:

Ingredient Stacks: When crafting, ingredients are now considered across multiple stacks, making the crafting process more efficient and accurate.
[hr][/hr]
Talent Points:

Unallocated Talent Points: If you have unallocated talent points, the talent icon will now be visually highlighted, and a notification will inform you that points are available to be spent.
[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:

World Map Fix: We broke the world map, but don’t worry – it’s fixed again!

– Your Usurpator Team

notes.title: Usurpator – Patch Notes June 2025
notes.notes:
June brings a variety of quality-of-life improvements and new convenience features for all conquerors out there. Here are this month’s highlights:

[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//35266443/20c2dafc8fe9f99cf588a33014f0f4f042350b96.png"]
[hr][/hr]🔧 Item Bar – Improved Handling
Items can now be added to or removed from the item bar using Ctrl + Left Click – quick and easy!

The auto-fill function for the item bar has been fixed.

Only usable objects can now be assigned.

Assigned items that are not present in the inventory are now shown with darkened icons.

Tooltips now support holding the Alt key to display additional information.
[hr][/hr]⚒️ Forge & Improvements
The upgrade area in the forge window now also supports Ctrl + Left Click – quickly assign or remove weapons.

Inventory slots now indicate an "IsBlocked" state if the item is currently in use.

The "IsBlocked" state now also works for stacks.

Tooltips in the Forge Improvement window have been fixed and now support the new interaction hotkeys.
[hr][/hr]🔊 New Sounds for More Immersion
Item Sell

Item Buy

Item Bar Drop

Inventory Drop

Forge Update

Forge Improvement

Equip Item
[hr][/hr]🗡️ Weapon Tooltips & Information
Improvement rune sockets are now always displayed in weapon tooltips.

New "Average Weapon Info Display": Default view shows baseline stats, and holding Alt reveals detailed values.
[hr][/hr]
Stay sharp, Usurpers – and don’t forget to tidy up your item bar! More comfort, more clarity, more control – June delivers.

– Your Usurpator Team
